rules.title: Newark fair chance in housing (Ban the Box), ch. 2:31 Art. 1
rules.requirement: Landlords and brokers may check criminal history only after a formal application and written notice and consent, must give 3 business days to submit rehabilitation evidence, and may only look back 8 years (indictable) or 5 years (disorderly persons/ordinance), plus pending charges and listed serious offenses at any time. Arrests without conviction, expunged and juvenile records may not be used; adverse decisions need written reasons within 10 business days.
rules.key_value: Criminal history inquiry only after formal application; 8-year (indictable) and 5-year (disorderly persons) lookback; fines up to $500 first, $1,000 repeat
rules.coverage_conditions: Any rental, lease or sublease of real property by a landlord or real estate broker in Newark
rules.exemptions: Single apartment in owner-occupied two-family dwelling; room rented in owner-occupied one-family dwelling; where federal or state law requires or permits criminal history consideration; properties in government programs housing people with criminal histories
rules.quoted_span: Inquiry into and consideration of any applicant's criminal history shall take place only after the applicant has submitted a formal application.
rules.interaction: Local fair chance rule; possible overlap with NJ state fair chance housing law (FAIR Act) taking effect later.

exempt_if.unavailable: single apartment in owner-occupied two-family dwelling, or room in owner-occupied one-family dwelling

notes: Editor's note: earlier Ord. 6 PSF-F (9-19-2012) was repealed in its entirety by Ord. 6 PSF-B (4-15-2015); the current Art. 1 Housing is Ord. 6 PSF-B, adopted 4-15-2015 (effective date not separately printed, adoption date used). Art. 2 (city licensing) is out of scope.
